You start with 5 tries and the goal is to keep at least 1 try under the timer.

Try a different configurable time - either 52 or 200 seconds!

Good luck!

R Wheel is a fast-pased one-button game. Try to survive inside a spinning wheel with spikes. Press a button to jump and hold a button to stay in the air longer. But your jumps release a wave that spawns the spikes. Collect bonus items to release a wave that clears the spikes and score points by clearing them. The game is over when you hit the spikes.
Truck Simulator Driver USA is an exciting video game that lets you experience the thrill of driving a truck in America.

Learn about a real Bigfoot - a creature that has learned to hide, survive and travel through other dimensions, and guide him through the mazes.

Among the most important events of the twentieth century, three stand out: man went into space; man has been to the moon; the man became convinced that he was not the only possessor of intelligence on Earth.

Years have passed. The planet is in the middle of the 21st century. Humanity is on the verge of extinction. Nuclear winter is raging. Officially, hominology is listed as a pseudoscience, but in fact it is the most important scientific discipline, because the object of its study is real.

Draco D, a casual dragon arcade game where players soar through enchanting levels, unleashing unique breath weapons and collecting magical power-ups to conquer foes. Maneuver through perilous obstacles, defeat monsters for rewards, and aim for high scores in this exhilarating quest.
Get ready to unleash the adrenaline-fueled fury of raw power on the asphalt! Dominate the tracks as you steer through an array of formidable challenges and rivals.

Available for free, Paku Paku is a proposal that transfers the action of Pac-Man to a one-dimensional maze of a single line with 16 points. In it, the goal of the protagonist (six pixels tall) is to eat points while avoiding the red ghost, an enemy that moves faster than you

Step into the feathery shoes of a daring pigeon in the heart of a bustling park with Pigeon Simulator Survival! This one-of-a-kind game promises a whimsical and utterly entertaining adventure that's bound to tickle your funny bone and keep you coming back for more.
Get ready for a fast-paced, magical combat/comedy game battling fearsome zombie hordes!

Extreme Bike Racing is ultimate 3D Bike Racing game for all age group. There are 3 stages with 3 challenges in every stage in which player has to face different hurdles and difficulties to complete that challenge.

SWARM is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are getting rushed by minions everywhere. You collect points by bombing them. The more you get in a single explosion, the more points you'll get.

If a minion touches you, it's game over, so be fast!
Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

Welcome to Project 13, a unique Walking Simulator that challenges your perception and instincts in a dystopian world. In this immersive experience, you step into the shoes of a disposable Probant, devoid of rights and a future, tasked with navigating a mysterious, repeating Hospital Corridor.

Your objective is clear: report any anomalies encountered during your walks. The catch? A single mistake means starting anew. Only by consistently reporting accurately can you progress through the enigmatic corridors.

Dive into festive fun with our new Christmas-themed game! Embark on a winter wonderland adventure featuring 8 mini-games that progressively intensify, putting your reflexes and holiday spirit to the test. Brace yourself for an ever-increasing thrill as the games get progressively more challenging. Embrace the holiday spirit, set high scores, and make this Christmas season unforgettable with our jolly game!

Hajwala isn’t typical drifting, it’s a vibe straight from the Gulf streets. Drift the Arab way, go into high speed and lose control on the highway. It’s all about sliding sideways with style on highways and open roads, showing oﬀ your skills while staying in full control. It’s loud, wild, and a lot of fun. In Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator you get to feel all that energy. Whether you’re cruising the desert or speeding through mountain roads, Customize everything during gameplay, your car is all about your style. Pick your favorite shade of color and choose your tint level, switch up the rims, and mix and match front and back bumpers to match your style. You can even customize your license plate to make it totally yours.

On Rock Canvas, you are the artist! With the help of a variety of tools, create sculptures for Rocky's cave. But be careful, Rocky is a little demanding with his sculptures, he will tell you what tool to use for his next great masterpiece!

Bpop is a captivating pop shooter where players strategically link colored explosions to annihilate balls in a top-down view. With every 10,000 points, earn extra balls, while utilizing the L stick to move your launcher, R stick to aim the projectile, and the X button to fire. Master the art of chaining combos to achieve the major goal of obliterating all balls on screen and unlock endless fun in this arcade challenge.

In Cybercop, embark on a nostalgic journey through a cyberpunk city as our pixelated hero, driven by a heartfelt mission - to find his loyal companion, a cybernetic dog. Navigate the neon-lit streets, battle Arcade-Bosses, confront enemy civilians, and combat cyber aliens, all in pursuit of reuniting with man's best friend.

Experience the excitement of "Worm War", where strategy and speed combine in a colorful, candy-inspired world. Navigate your worm with fluid 360-degree movement and outsmart AI opponents in this engaging single-player adventure.

Enhance your gameplay with special skills: Dash to surge forward, Shield for collision protection, and Magnetic to attract food effortlessly. Grow your worm, unlock diverse maps, and personalize your journey. With each game, challenge yourself to beat high scores and master the art of Worm War!

Total Trails is here to provide you with the most authentic mountain biking experience ever. We've taken realism to the next level, ensuring that you feel every bump, every turn, and every adrenaline rush as you navigate challenging trails.

Pink Pong is a classic arcade-style game where two players compete in a fast-paced and skillful showdown. Take control of your paddle and go head-to-head with your opponent in a thrilling battle of reflexes and precision. Use your paddle to bounce the ball past your adversary and score points, but be on guard - they're aiming to do the same! The first player to reach the target score wins. Enjoy the timeless simplicity and competitive fun of this classic arcade game brought to the digital age. Pink Pong is perfect for quick matches and high-energy gaming sessions.
In this game, you merge two tiny fruits to increase their size and eventually form giant watermelons.
Help the brave chicken go through dozens of interesting puzzle levels where you must show wit and make timely decisions.

Road Bustle Online is a competitive online game for up to 8 players on the road in real-time, set in the streets of the Road Bustle world. Bright graphics and pulsating rhythms set the stage for adrenaline-filled sessions. Navigate your way through increasing traffic, dodge vehicles, and outsmart your opponents to reach the finish line. Ready? On your marks!

This is a difficult game about climbing.

Dive into EzQuiz, where hundreds of questions across diverse topics await to challenge your knowledge and sharpen your wits. How much do you really know?

EzQuiz has it all! Test your mastery across a universe of subjects in the most dynamic quiz game ever. Are you ready to become the ultimate quiz champion?
Jump around bouncing off walls and collecting stars, but avoid the spikes!

STOP10 is an arcade game that mixes fast reflexes with simple sums.

Your objective is to make the counter and the moving number to sum 10. However, the counter is rapidly moving so you'll have to be quick and sharp! The faster you answer, the more points you get!

The counter has a timer which refills when you get a correct answer and drops when you miss. If it drops to 0, it's game over!
Help NyaKaMon to get through challenging levels of sokoban!

Pedal to the metal, and turn the wheel to the right and... to the right!?

Looks like your car has a few technical issues, and the wheel can't turn left! Keep on moving, avoid obstacles and collect coins to speed up! Each coin will throw another obstacle so be careful... but hey, at least the brakes work!

You'll score by picking up coins and moving at high speeds! The faster, the more each coin's worth, but don't be afraid to hit the brakes if things get too hectic. However, if your speed reduces to 0 or you hit a wall or obstacle, you'll lose!
Invasion of Space is a 2D shooter in a distant space. Find strength to fend off waves of enemy ships and defeat Boss. Good luck on your journey!

Take an adventure with Heaven Jump, the endless jumping game! Fly to new heights in this fun challenge where you'll try to reach the highest score and collect stars along the way. Dive into the world of Heaven Jump, where classic 2D pixel arcade design adds a touch of nostalgia to your space journey. Elevate your gaming experience and reach for the stars.

Face off against swarms of enemies, as you try to avoid them while collecting power ups and weapons.

Easter Journey is a delightful puzzle game designed to celebrate the enchanting atmosphere of Easter. Flip Easter-themed cards to uncover matching pairs.

The game offers four different difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert. Each level challenges players' memory and attention skills while immersing them in the joyous holiday spirit with adorable Easter characters and atmospheric music.

Easter Journey, with its four distinct difficulty levels, adds an extra layer of joy to your Easter celebrations!
From Four Sides is a game in which you control a yellow square and must dodge flying spikes in four directions. Points are awarded for dodging spikes. The game ends when the spike hits you.

Non-linear platformer action game about a shaman and his mask.

Experience the thrill of stacking and merging fruits in this deceptively simple yet captivating gameplay. Drop various fruits into the box and watch as the physics come alive, making them roll, shift, and merge upon contact.
Create mesmerizing chain reactions by merging identical fruits, building up to the ultimate Watermelon – not only a points bonanza but also a container-consuming giant.

A new Observer Gametype where you take on the role of an Observer tasked with guarding the HQ of the Project 13 Corp. . Prevent any Observer Prisoner, each potentially containing a anomaly, from infiltrating the HQ. Equipped with a high-tech binocular, your observation skills are the key to success.

Discover pulse-pounding stylized parkour action as you run, jump, smash, and slide through an afro-futurist-inspired kingdom. Enjoy a single-player or two-player local cooperative mode and experience the story of two brothers and their unexpected return to their lost kingdom.

Cosmic Paradox: Noire is a 2D top-down shoot ‘em up adventure set in a world of two overlapping dimensions. Witness the battle between the Vex Accord and the Oronix Empire, increase your odds of survival with the right upgrades and choose a ship that is best suited to your playstyle.

A real-time tactics game from Destructive Creations taking place during WWII. The capital city of Poland, Warsaw, is under occupation of German forces, however there are groups of fearless people who are not afraid to face the enemy. 63 Days follows the steps of their previous game War Mongrels to deliver a Commandos-like game play set in the darkest days of human history.
Zoochosis is a bodycam horror simulation game. You’re a night zookeeper. Identify infected mutant animals, make a vaccine and cure them. Will you save all of them and survive?

Help Sam and Elicy on their challenging journey through the abyss. An epic 2D precision platform game where exploring the unknown, overcoming obstacles, and discovering secrets are crucial to reaching the top of the abyss. Adventure awaits you!
Old Market Simulator is a coop bazaar adventure for 1-2 players. Dive into commerce, manage your reputation, and build your dream market together.

Detective The Motel is a deduction game where, to advance, you must take a pencil and a piece of paper and write down everything that seems like evidence in order to answer all the questions that arise. Solving the case will depend only on you.

You are brought into a racing league, the SRK. Once you can qualify and prove yourself to the league, you then make your way to the top, racing against various competitors, and taking down stage bosses to move up in rank! Multiple vehicles, customization, open world maps, and more!

A-Red Walking Robot is a physics based toy robot simulator where you pilot tiny A-Red, a small clockwork operated robot that needs to overcome the trials it’s creator set in a workshop. A miniature nerve-wrecking/patience-proving journey where you are granted to fall… a lot.

A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

Distance is a survival racing game where you pilot a versatile car through a mysterious, ruined world, using boost, jump, rotate, and flight abilities to navigate treacherous tracks and uncover the story of its past. It blends arcade-style racing with exploration, offering solo adventure, multiplayer modes, a built-in level editor with Steam Workshop support, and an original soundtrack.

Have a nice Halloween in a lovely and casual way with a one-button game that tries to bring back the competition of the arcade era, where you need to shoot a pumpkin towards to a cauldron while dodging obstacles, a simple mechanic that's easy to understand, but hard to master, this game can please casual gamers as well as hardcore ones.

Kemonomichi Girlish Square follows Taiga Nakamori, an idol fan working in Akihabara who discovers that a group of underground idols are secretly magical girls fighting supernatural threats. As he supports their activities as both manager and producer, he grows closer to the heroines through a branching story filled with comedy, romance, and character-driven choices.

Immerse yourself in the fast-paced world of Gemz, where your shield stands as the last line of defense against advancing gemstones. Use precise control to block and smash gems, collecting powerups, coins, and facing off against mini-bosses along the way. As time ticks away, the gems intensify in speed, testing your reflexes and strategic thinking. Combine powerups for ultimate survival as you strive for the highest score and become the ultimate Gemz master!

Heritage of Eternal Splitting is an exciting puzzle-adventure game, pitting players against challenging missions in a mysterious world. This game will draw you in with its unique game mechanics and impressive atmosphere.

1-2-Word Search is a classic word search puzzle game with a TreeFall twist! As you complete and solve each word search puzzle you unlock new background music to change up the mood of each puzzle.

Embark on a fun and relaxing time solving word searches while listening to the TreeFall Radio!

Invaders from different systems have united against you! Fight them off! Do not run out of life before invaders run out of reinforcements!
Father's Day Journey is a delightful puzzle game designed to celebrate the enchanting atmosphere of Father's Day. Flip Father's Day themed cards to uncover matching pairs.

The 2nd game in the Lost Chiko series, this time with a different adventure, a different story and a different gameplay!
One day while we were sleeping under a tree, a bird comes and tells us that our mother has been kidnapped.
Dragonic Resurgence is a metroidvania where you have to explore different locations, collect upgrades and fight different bosses.
Fly through Portals in a city but don't collide with any obstacle!

We all know that mice really love cheese.

Guide the little mouse through 30 short levels and help her collect all the cheese pieces on the way. Watch out for tiny holes in the floor. If your mouse falls inside, you have to start the level from the beginning.

Complete all 30 levels for victory. A short and fun experience that can be enjoyed by players of all ages.

You are a ball, you must dodge things. It is as easy as that!

Simple one button controls yet still challenging.

Octopo exploring the sandy shores. Collect shells scattered across the beach to earn points. Along the way, they'll encounter special items that grant temporary boosts like speed, double coins, or invincibility. But watch out! The beach isn't just a serene playground; it's also home to pesky enemies like snails with shells (slugs) and the occasional bomb dropping from above, ready to explode. With each shell collected and enemy evaded, players strive to achieve the highest score possible, making "Octopo" a thrilling adventure of skill and strategy.

Penguin's Road is a fast and fun 3rd-person action shooter. The player is given an arsenal of weapons and tools to defeat enemies that attack from the land, the sea and the air. The game rewards improvisation: run-and-gun, cover-to-cover, long aim, short blast, hand-to-hand or commandeering tanks!
Take on the role of Big B and pilot a unique spaceship in the shape of a burger through infinite space!

Runnero is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

Zaggy Car is an endless journey through the desert where players collect money to unlock new cars. The more money they gather, the faster they go, making it increasingly challenging. Along the way, players can grab special items like double coins or a magnet for a limited time. The goal? Accumulate as much money as possible!

Welcome to a new racing bros party adventure that will challenge your skills once more. Try the epic extraction challenge across the world or fight against your friends in crazy party modes. Are you ready for some more racing bros?

Retaliate is a vertically scrolling space shooter with the unique gameplay mechanic being that the player starts with no ammo. Instead the player has a shield and is able to use it to both destroy enemies and absorb their weapons. Absorbed weapons can then be fired by the player.

In this retro-style arcade game, you have to save your corn from the crows!

Shoot the crows from a slingshot to prevent them from stealing corn!

A genre-bending RPG inspired by the classic Paper Mario games! Embark on a quest to battle Ever After Inc, a greedy megacorp from the real world, as they seize control of fairytales for their cheap labor! Escape from Ever After: Onboarding is a prologue ver. of the game Escape from Ever After.

Embark on a thrilling quest in 'Find The Thing'! In this immersive game, players are challenged to locate specific objects amidst a chaotic landscape of spawning items. With each successful discovery, players earn points and time, while the stakes increase with more objects spawning. As the score climbs, so does the intensity, with a cluttered playing field making each find more challenging. The ultimate goal? Achieve the highest score possible in this endless adventure of observation and quick thinking!
Educational game teaching you fundamental spelling of Hangul.

More than just another puzzle game. Puzzle Drop Carnival highlights the fun part of puzzle-solving.

Who does not love the good old 'Tetra'-style mechanics? With “Tetra Mode”, the jigsaw is now tetra-saw! Try out Tetra to find out the perfect combination between jigsaw style and 'Tetra'-style games.
One simple but hard rule here - you must react very quickly to constantly changing conditions, tasks and speed. A challenge for real players with exceptional skills!

Meteo Planet is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to collect as many coins as you can without getting caught by a meteorite. Avoid meteorites while rotating around the planet's axis. The closer the coin is to the meteorite, the more points it brings, but be careful not to get hit by the meteorite itself.
Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia is Quiz Game for kids for age 5 and above. This game helps everyone to increase their knowledge by completing various different trivia challenges.

Space Surveyor is an arcade-style UFO surveying and landing game. Your objective is to collect coins, avoid enemies, and land in a designated landing spot. Master the UFO controls and rack up these high scores!

Embark on an exciting 2D adventure under the ocean!
In this puzzle platformer game, where we manage a magical and unusual whale,
we not only overcome obstacles by jumping,
but also create our own path by positioning your dead bodies at the right points.
In this adventure you have to prove not only your reflexes and speed but also your strategic and mind skills.
Determine your own strategy, Try to finish the level as fast as possible!
Nobody asked for it, yet the sequel to “Baby Boomer” is out 35 years after the original! This is literally breaking the world record for the longest time in-between video game sequels!
Collect a coin treasure underwater, but avoid the sea mines and the fish.
A retro arcade game with several difficulty modes, as well as high score and best time stats.
Do you like whips? Have you ever wanted an accurate, next-generation, stimulating whip simulator? Well, this game is far from it, but at least it tries!

Enter the battlefield of Minefield Combat, an intense and strategic tower defense game where quick thinking and precision are your keys to survival. As waves of relentless enemies advance, you must strategically place and upgrade your mortar towers to protect your territory.

Immerse yourself in the fast-paced action with rapid consumption gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Each mortar tower boasts unique attack patterns and abilities, allowing for endless strategic combinations. Earn and manage your resources wisely to upgrade your defenses and adapt to the ever-increasing challenge.

Navigate through meticulously designed mid-poly warfare-themed environments, from war-torn landscapes to fortified trenches. Each level presents a new battlefield with its own strategic elements, ensuring no two battles are the same.

Whether you're a casual gamer or a strategic mastermind, Minefield Combat offers a thrilling and engaging defense experience for all. Prepare your defenses, upgrade your towers, and become the ultimate defender in Minefield Combat.

Correct Picture is an engaging and educational game where players are challenged to match pictures on the left with their corresponding names on the right. The objective is to correctly pair as many names with images as possible. The more correct matches a player makes, the higher their score. This game tests and improves the player's recognition and association skills, making it both fun and informative.
Sort the fruits of this season!

In PILEUP you play as a green square that is trying to rise up by substituting gray squares underneath it. Since reaching the top of the green square will end the game, you must prevent it from rising. Pink rectangles will fall from above and destroy all the blocks in their path, including you. Dodge them to live as long as possible and earn more points.

Mushroom Colors is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a vibrant mushroom. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your mushroom can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your mushroom's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

Main challenge lies in maneuvering the water stream around various obstacles that block the direct path to the glass. However, the player doesn't have an infinite supply of water. This means that players must use their resources wisely, ensuring they avoid unnecessary obstacles and carefully plan their water usage to collect all the stars and to make a happy glass full of water.

Toss fruits to find their matching pairs! As you play, the fruits change color and become trickier to match, adding an exciting challenge. Designed with young players in mind, it’s a simple, kid-friendly experience perfect for even the littlest hands. Bright visuals and easy-to-understand gameplay make it a joyful adventure for all ages!

You will have a long and difficult road to victory. You know it's better not to go it alone, right? Get your Boys together and get to the finish! Not everyone will make it, but those who do will help the others reach the finish line. It's a team effort and a team victory.
Roll your tough fighting beasts into the arena and compete for the right to be the best. Even the cute panda can beat his rivals, and the turtle isn't so slow when it comes to the big animal fight.

Imagine a mix of classic snake and puzzle game 2048 and there you have a unique gameplay in front of you that you can try right now. Run and grow your snake on different challenging levels and discover new big numbers on the cubes.
Help the little furry lump get out of this strange post office, where obstacles await at every turn.
A unique blend of classic snake gameplay and harvesting simulators. Try out these new battle arenas and prove you are the one and only champion.
A new way to experience car drifting. Enjoy every turn in a calm and easy driving. Just let your car drift and slide down the road. Catch the Zen!

Live the life of a rookie paramedic through frantic minigame action and a wild, funny story. Juggle waves of patients with a battle-like triage system; master dozens of treatment minigames; and win the city's recognition from the rival fire department!
Are you ready to experience Talisman like never before in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition? Play the newest digital adaptation of the iconic board game.
Grandpa goes on a retro, third-person, action-adventure game, with his grandson after he got a phone call.

A nuclear disaster has left an area of Britain in tatters. Atomfall, a new survival-action game, will see you explore, scavenge, craft, barter and fight your way through beautifully recreated scenery in search of answers.

Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!
Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

Vigilante Ranger is a tower defense game in first person view and in virtual reality.
The player must protect your own base against hordes of enemies using several weapons, all this immersed in a dystopian and monumental future.

In memory of a woman he never met, Noah SmallJohnson creates the most epic puzzle game ever. Featuring high-score gameplay, catchy tunes, multiple arcade modes, and a Game Show where players can win cheat codes. It’s weird, it’s wild, and it’s unapologetically heartfelt.

Embark on an intergalactic journey in this adrenaline-pumping 2D space shooter! Pilot your sleek spacecraft through treacherous enemy armadas as you battle to save the galaxy from imminent destruction. With intuitive controls and fast-paced action, blast your way through wave after wave of alien invaders. Dodge incoming fire, shoot enemies in this thrilling arcade-style adventure. Are you ready to become the hero the universe desperately needs?

Help a lively frog collect tasty fruits while avoiding hazards. Use simple left and right controls to gather nutritious treats and enjoy a fun, stress-free experience with no lives to lose or defeats to worry about!

P Fit is a puzzle game in which the player has to match the top and bottom pieces to move to the next level.

Both walls move slowly towards each other, if they touch you will have to start all over again. Your goal as a player is to last as long as possible.

Embark on an unprecedented retail adventure with "Martian Supermarket Sim," where you spearhead the first supermarket venture on the dusty red plains of Mars, within the bustling colony of New Olympus. This is more than a business—it’s a cornerstone of a new civilization.

Explore a meticulously recreated Europe, delivering cargo across iconic landmarks and diverse landscapes. Master the challenges of the road, manage your virtual trucker's well-being, and customize your rig to become a legend of the European trucking scene!

Get ready to rumble in Amer Fighting, the ultimate party fighting game where the fun never stops! Gather your friends and dive into an exciting family fight for up to 6 players as each battle is a chance to become a legend! In Amer Fighting, everyone can fight, but only one can win!

Chimp Test is an innovative and engaging memory challenge game designed to push the boundaries of your cognitive abilities and thoroughly test your short-term memory skills. Inspired by the exceptional memory feats of chimpanzees, who have demonstrated remarkable ability in recalling complex sequences with astonishing speed and precision, Chimp Test offers a unique and interactive experience for players of all ages. Whether you are a casual gamer looking for an entertaining challenge or a dedicated enthusiast aiming to sharpen your mental acuity, this game provides a dynamic platform to enhance memory, concentration, and mental agility.

"Operation Bodycam" offers an immersive first-person experience where players step into the role of a special unit officer, equipped with a body-worn camera that records all actions for later review. The game features realistic, tactical missions based on real-life police scenarios, such as hostage rescues and raids, requiring strategic planning and quick decision-making.

Players must navigate dynamic environments, adapt to various settings, and coordinate with AI teammates to succeed. Each choice has significant consequences, influencing the storyline and mission outcomes. A skill progression system allows for customization and improvement, while realistic graphics and sound add to the intensity of the experience.

A narrative-based action game with adventure elements.

- Oppose the whimsical bosses by finding out how to pass by them
- Stay unharmed with all those different enemies
- Limited Praying power only available on some levels
- Press X to change the situation with the Prayer
- Pass through the mini story of passions and ire boiling in one tiny soul

A small game where you control a rabbit escaping from the darkness that is chasing him. You need to jump on clouds to progress and use soap bubbles to jump even higher. During the game, you can encounter several types of power-up bonuses to gain a temporary advantage.

Bubble Aim is an exciting game where bubbles of various colors and sizes descend from the sky. The player must shoot these bubbles, causing them to either burst or split into smaller bubbles. Each successful shot earns the player points. The objective is to shoot as many bubbles as possible without letting them fall to the ground. The game is endless, challenging players to achieve the highest score possible by continuously popping bubbles. How many bubbles can you shoot?

1-2-Whopping Word Search is sequel to "1-2-Word Search!" packed with all new features! This game now utilizes multiple grid sizes for both large and small puzzles. As a skilled thief, you'll navigate a series of daring robberies, from simple snatches to elaborate capers. Plan your operations meticulously, equip yourself with advanced tools, and upgrade your skills to become the ultimate heist artist.

Deer Hunting Camp allows you to create your own private deer habitat which can be traded with friends! Once done creating, managing, and scouting your property you will be challenged with early fall bow hunting, late fall black powder hunting, and winter rifle hunting.

Desert Tank Chaos – The Battle in the Desert Begins!

Can you survive the chaos in the scorching desert? Desert Tank Chaos is an action-packed tank warfare game! Fight your way through 6 uniquely designed levels, commanding your powerful tank against relentless enemies. But beware—it's not just rival tanks you'll face! Deadly aircraft patrol the skies, strategic watchtowers guard key locations, and enemy soldiers are ready to ambush you at any moment.

Use your heavy artillery, dodge incoming attacks, and find the best way to survive in the desert! Think tactically, plan your assaults, and conquer the battlefield amidst the chaos.

Are you ready, Commander? The desert awaits!

From the creative minds behind Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the most exciting soccer puzzle game of the year: Football Striker 2025!
Dive into the world of soccer with this sequel and experience 20 new football-related levels that will challenge your gray matter.

Over 20 tricky levels are waiting for you!

Get Football Striker 2025 now and become a legend on the virtual pitch!

Gear up and answer the call with "Firefighting Heroes: Truck 911 Simulator." Step into the role of a dedicated firefighter in this thrilling simulation, where you'll tackle fires across over 30 diverse areas inspired by real American locations. Experience the urgency of emergency response as you drive fire trucks, wield authentic firefighting tools, and save lives in a variety of challenging scenarios.

In this small arcade game, the player controls two catchers simultaneously—one on the right and one on the left. In the game, particles always move toward each other, and they must be caught at the point of collision using either the right or left catcher. If an annihilation is missed and it explodes, the player will lose one heart. Losing three hearts results in a game over.

Valentine Revolution is a high-energy, arcade-style shooter where you control Cupid in a heart-shaped hovercraft, shooting Valentine’s Day-themed objects like chocolates, hearts, and rings. Clear waves of romantic icons, dodge enemy attacks, and conquer increasingly challenging levels in this whimsical, love-filled adventure!

With 1,000 carefully designed levels, the challenge gradually increases—from simple and satisfying early stages to truly demanding logic puzzles that will put your brain to the test. Whether you're looking to unwind or train your mind, this game offers the perfect blend of fun, focus, and colorful satisfaction.

The Flying Car is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. Your task is to safely transport soldiers between bases through difficult routes, overcoming off-road terrain, checkpoints and other obstacles.

In Beat Heaven Symphony, rhythm isn’t just heard — it’s felt.
With 20 unique tracks, every beat is a challenge, every note a step in your musical journey.
From Easy to Expert, test your timing and let your fingers dance.
Hit the right keys at the right moment and become the master of rhythm.
The music is rising... the stage is yours, the tempo is with you!

Embark on the Strawberry Jumping Journey and help the strawberry navigate through the forest! With countless obstacles blocking her path, you'll need to rely on the power of the quadruple jump to overcome them. Stay focused and survive as long as possible to achieve the highest score!

Celebrate the special day with Remember Easter, a festive card-matching memory game perfect for all ages! Flip cards to reveal delightful Easter-themed icons like bunnies, eggs, and chocolate, while testing your memory across increasing levels of fun and challenge. With cheerful visuals, cozy music, and endless holiday spirit, it’s the perfect way to make your gaming season merry and bright!

The Jumping Bird is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a the bird. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your bird can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your bird's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

Buckle up and soar to new heights in Airplane Racing Championship - the ultimate high-speed aerial racing experience! Compete against elite pilots in stunning environments, from bustling cityscapes to treacherous mountain, Beach, Many More.

Get ready for a pulse-pounding platforming challenge in Colorful Boi 2! With 74 meticulously designed levels, you'll test your reflexes, precision, and patience against a gauntlet of devious traps and hazards.

Step into the shadows of a world where power is taken, not given. In this underground simulator, you're building more than a business—you're creating an empire from nothing. No cash, no allies—just ambition, strategy, and the will to rise. Every move matters. Every mistake leaves a mark.
Akinakes is a fast-paced shoot 'em up game where you pilot a powerful ship through vibrant levels, collect upgrades to enhance your firepower, and take on epic boss battles.

Toy Drop Balance Challenge is an endless arcade game that tests your precision and balancing skills. Toys drop from above, landing on a tower of blocks. Your goal? Tap to destroy blocks, score points, and keep the tower balanced. The higher the score, the greater the challenge how long can you keep your tower standing?

In this puzzle game you freeze the enemies into solid cubes by guiding them to an Ice Crystal. Move the enemies around and match them into lines of 3 or more to destroy them. Finish all 21 levels of mind-bending puzzle!
A thrilling and engaging chain reaction game that will keep you hooked till the end!

Reflex Master: Sight is a fast and simple reflex game that puts your reaction speed to the test! Watch closely and click as soon as the signal appears. Your total reaction time across 5 quick rounds determines your final score—and your rank! Can you beat your personal best and rise above the rank of Snail? A perfect pick-up-and-play experience for sharpening reflexes and challenging friends offline!

Twist it is an endless arcade game in which the player moves along a twisting branch, turning left or right to avoid obstacles. The game challenges reflexes and timing, as the branch is constantly accelerating and requires quick decisions to keep you on the right path.

Candy Storm Bunny Catcher puts you in the paws of a speedy bunny racing to collect falling candies while dodging bombs from the sky! Rack up points as the sugary storm intensifies, with everything falling faster and faster. Move left and right to avoid danger, catch as much candy as you can, and aim for the highest score. How many points can you earn before the storm overwhelms you?

Become the ultimate housekeeper in this fast-paced retro arcade challenge! Clean hotel rooms as quickly as possible to keep the guests happy and the hotel running. Inspired by classic 80s games, Guest Rush delivers pixel-perfect nostalgia with charming 8-bit visuals and sounds. Can you keep up with the rush?

In this flight simulator, you’ll explore a globe-inspired open-world map featuring diverse regions and unique climates. With an impressive selection of 31 realistic airplanes, enjoy a fully immersive commercial aviation experience provided by advanced flight controls, realistic interiors and sound effects, full day-night cycle and challenging weather scenarios.

Gemstones Rush Mania is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop square gemstones into four columns, aiming to align and clear full rows for points. The closest row to the player must be perfectly aligned to disappear, triggering combos if rows below are also aligned. Occasionally, wooden blocks appear, requiring two hits to break before the row can be cleared. As the game progresses, the speed increases, making it more challenging. How long can you keep up, and what high score can you achieve?

Join the Neon strike team as they continue to fight against an invading enemy force.

- Master evasion for a greater chance of survival

Underwater Submarine Rush is a thrilling endless game where you pilot a submarine through dangerous underwater terrain. Avoid obstacles, destroy them with standard shots or homing missiles, and activate a shield for protection when needed. Collect power-ups like extra ammo and health to extend your journey. The goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score!

Hard difficulty TPS roguelike with randomly generated dungeons. The protagonist, Willow Martin, has no memory of her past, but when a fight begins, her body moves naturally and she displays exceptional combat abilities.

Step into the world of Anomaly Seeker: The Diner, a thrilling anomaly detection puzzle game that tests your attention to detail and memory! Set in a charming and atmospheric diner, you’ll need to carefully examine the room and identify hidden anomalies. But the challenge doesn’t stop there—on your next visit, the room may look the same, but there’s a twist! You’ll need to recall the details and determine if something’s changed. Only the most observant will be able to find all the anomalies and solve the mysteries lurking within. Featuring 27 anomalies. Can you find them all?

Join Selene in a charming platforming and puzzle adventure, where her ability to absorb and emit light from various flowers is key to activating mechanisms, overcoming obstacles, and navigating through environments that adjust depending on how you wield the light.

Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.
A 2D Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.
